fairytail.name: Fairy Tail
fairytail.note: covers 2009 series + 2014 series (EP1-277); Final Season is key fairytailfinalseason
fairytail.summary: Lucy Heartfilia, a young celestial wizard, dreams of joining the famous and famously rowdy Fairy Tail guild. She gets her wish after meeting Natsu Dragneel, a fire-eating Dragon Slayer searching for the dragon who raised him, and his flying cat Happy. Together with their guildmates they take on jobs, rival guilds and dark wizards across the kingdom of Fiore.

soulland.name: Soul Land
soulland.note: S1 finished (EP263) but 3 eps missing; 'Season 2' uploads are actually Soul Land 2 EP95-141
soulland.summary: Tang San, a prodigy of the Tang Sect of hidden weapons, is reborn in a world where everyone awakens a martial spirit that decides their path in life. Born as a blacksmith's son in a small village, he discovers he carries unusual spirits and rare potential, and he sets out to train at academies and rise as a Spirit Master.

amortalsjourney.name: A Mortal's Journey (from EP77)
amortalsjourney.note: continues the Remastered entry (amortalsjourneytoimmortalityremake, EP1-76): starts at EP77; S2-S5 are compilations of EP22-176 already in S1, skipped; mostly multi-episode collections; members-only gaps; still ongoing (Sea of Stars arc)
amortalsjourney.summary: Han Li is a poor village boy with no special talent who is taken in as a helper by a small martial sect. When he stumbles onto a mysterious bottle that speeds the growth of medicinal herbs, he quietly begins cultivating immortal arts, relying on caution, patience and cunning to survive a ruthless world of cultivators on his long road toward immortality.

perfectworld.name: Perfect World
perfectworld.summary: Shi Hao is a boy raised in a small village in the wild Great Wilderness. As an infant he was robbed of a rare, powerful bone that marked him for greatness, yet he grows up tough and fearless anyway. Training with the villagers and the spirit that guards them, he sets out into a world of ancient beasts, clans and sects, determined to grow stronger and uncover his origins.

tenthousandworlds.name: Ten Thousand Worlds
tenthousandworlds.note: Anime-Planet 3.844 of 5 from 184 votes (season 1 page, Wan Jie Duzun); ongoing multi-season; members-only gaps
tenthousandworlds.summary: Lin Feng is left for dead when his fiancée steals his rare sword martial soul. The betrayal awakens a hidden phoenix bloodline and makes him master of a mysterious burial ground of gods. Shunned by his clan but backed by family, he sets out to rebuild his strength and climb the martial world.

spiritswordsovereign.name: Spirit Sword Sovereign
spiritswordsovereign.note: Anime-Planet 3.7 of 5 from 370 votes (season 1 entry, Ling Jian Zun); ongoing; members-only gaps
spiritswordsovereign.summary: A once-mighty warrior finds himself reborn in the body of a young, weak nobleman. Carrying the memories of his past life and its mistakes, he takes up the path of the spirit sword to rebuild his strength, settle old scores and climb toward supremacy across the three realms.

swallowedstar.name: Swallowed Star
swallowedstar.summary: After a deadly virus sweeps the planet and monsters overrun most of it, humanity lives in fortified cities where trained martial artists fight the beasts. Luo Feng, a young man from an ordinary family, is determined to become a warrior so he can provide for his loved ones, and his growing strength sets him on a path toward far greater powers and threats.

reborn.name: Reborn!
reborn.summary: Tsunayoshi Sawada is a clumsy middle schooler who fails at nearly everything, until a baby hitman named Reborn shows up at his door. Reborn announces that Tsuna is the heir to the Vongola, a powerful Italian mafia family, and sets out to train him as its next boss with dangerous and absurd methods, while Tsuna gathers an unlikely circle of friends and guardians.

againsttheskysupreme.name: Against the Sky Supreme
againsttheskysupreme.note: Anime-Planet 3.77 of 5 from 104 votes; ongoing (2021 onward); members-only gaps
againsttheskysupreme.summary: Tan Yun has been cast down and humiliated, but after enduring countless lifetimes of torment he wakes with the memories and power of his former self restored. Returning to the family and the woman he lost, he sets out to protect those he loves and settle scores with everyone who wronged or underestimated him, climbing the cultivation world on the way.

bigbrother.name: Big Brother
bigbrother.note: Anime-Planet 3.929 of 5 from 149 votes (S1 entry, 13 eps 2023; S2 26 eps 2023-24, S3 also listed); ongoing; members-only gaps in S1
bigbrother.summary: A modern man is reborn in an ancient world of qi cultivators and sets out to reach immortality while keeping his head down and his strength hidden. His quiet routine as senior disciple is upended when his master brings home a lively new junior sister, pulling the overly cautious hero into adventures that keep threatening to expose how powerful he really is.

throneofseal.name: Throne of Seal
throneofseal.note: series ended around EP208 but uploads incomplete; EP999 is a parse outlier

mythofeternity.name: Myth of Eternity
mythofeternity.note: Anime-Planet 3.723 of 5 from 57 votes; still airing (Anime-Planet lists 280 eps, 2022 to 2025); members-only gaps

demongods.name: Tales of Demons and Gods
demongods.note: Yao Shen Ji; ongoing; collections with members-only gaps

hunterhunter.name: Hunter x Hunter
hunterhunter.summary: Twelve-year-old Gon Freecss learns that the father he never knew is a famed Hunter, an elite licensed adventurer, and sets off to pass the brutal Hunter Exam and track him down. Along the way he befriends Killua, the runaway heir of an assassin family, the vengeful Kurapika and the easygoing Leorio, and the group heads into a world of dangerous jobs and powerful rivals.

onehundredthousandyearsofqirefining.name: One Hundred Thousand Years of Qi Refining
onehundredthousandyearsofqirefining.note: Anime-Planet 3.996 of 5 from 117 votes; ongoing; members-only gaps
onehundredthousandyearsofqirefining.summary: Xu Yang is a sect disciple who never advanced past the Qi Refining stage while everyone around him moved on. After ten thousand years in seclusion he emerges to find the cultivation world in decline and his Tian Lan Sect close to extinction. He sets out to restore the sect while digging into why his own cultivation stalled and what links the human, demon and immortal realms.

onesteptowardsfreedom.name: One Step Toward Freedom
onesteptowardsfreedom.note: Dubu Xiaoyao; Anime-Planet 3.628 of 5 from 147 votes; show finished 2024 at 480 eps but uploads have members-only gaps (32 missing)
onesteptowardsfreedom.summary: Ye Yu is pulled from his own world into a land of cultivators and lands right in front of a sect leader who urgently needs a stand-in husband for his daughter. Pushed into the marriage almost at once, Ye Yu begins walking the path of cultivation while trying to find his footing in the sect.

thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime.note: S2 full upload skipped: S1 EP1-48 already holds season 2; S4 is a five-cour run started April 2026, still airing; S1/S2 uploaded as compilations
thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime.summary: Satoru Mikami, a 37-year-old office worker, is stabbed to death and wakes up in a fantasy world as a slime with odd skills, including the power to devour things and copy their abilities. After befriending the sealed Storm Dragon Veldora, he takes the name Rimuru Tempest. He begins protecting the monsters around him, and his growing band of followers sets out to build a peaceful nation.

renegadeimmortal.name: Renegade Immortal
renegadeimmortal.summary: Wang Lin is a boy of ordinary talent from a poor village who longs to become a cultivator. After barely getting into a cultivation sect, he finds a mysterious bead that changes his fate. Determined and ruthless when he must be, he climbs the harsh world of immortal cultivation in pursuit of power and eternal life.

legendofxianwu.name: Legend of Xianwu
legendofxianwu.note: ongoing; Anime-Planet 3.8 of 5 from 116 votes (season 1 entry, 26 eps, 2023; later seasons have separate entries)
legendofxianwu.summary: Ye Chen is a loyal sect disciple who tends a field of spiritual herbs. When rivals destroy the field and he is thrown out of the sect for it, a celestial flame comes to his aid and sets him on the path of cultivation. Growing stronger, he sets out to repay those who betrayed him and carve out his own fate.

peerlessmartialspirit.name: Peerless Martial Spirit
peerlessmartialspirit.note: Jueshi Wuhun; ongoing (about 449 eps by late 2024); members-only gaps; no rating found (Anime-Planet only lists the manga)
peerlessmartialspirit.summary: Chen Feng grows up on the Longmai continent with a dantian that cannot hold cultivation. After his master is apparently murdered he keeps watch at the grave for five years, until he learns the death was faked and finds Supreme Dragon Blood hidden in an ancient tripod. Newly empowered, he sets out to grow strong and track his master down.

supremegodemperor.name: Supreme God Emperor
supremegodemperor.summary: Mu Yun was once a fairy king at the top of a vast universe of rival realms. After his fall he is reborn as a bullied, illegitimate son of a family that looks down on him. Starting from that weak body, he sets out to cultivate again, repay those who scorned him and climb back to the peak he once held.

awilleternal.name: A Will Eternal
awilleternal.note: S1-2 only as compilations with gaps; S3 ongoing
awilleternal.summary: Bai Xiaochun is a cowardly village boy terrified of dying, so he joins the Spirit Stream Sect in hopes of learning the secret to living forever. Rather than fighting, he pours his energy into pill-making and defensive arts, and his knack for causing chaos keeps getting him into trouble. His quest for immortality gradually drags him into wars between sects.

legendofskylord.name: The Legend of Sky Lord
legendofskylord.note: Shenwu Tianzun (2020 series, 253 eps, 2020-2025); Anime-Planet 3.73 of 5 from 50 votes; uploads end at EP251 with members-only gaps; separate 2024 24-ep remake on Anime-Planet (3.641 from 32 votes) not this key
legendofskylord.summary: Xiao Chen was once a martial master of unmatched strength, until he fell during his ascent and awoke centuries later in the body of a weak young man. With his old knowledge intact but his power gone, he sets out to rebuild his cultivation, protect those close to him and learn what happened in the years he was gone.

magicchefoficeandfire.name: The Magic Chef of Ice and Fire
magicchefoficeandfire.note: ongoing; Anime-Planet 3.83 of 5 from 159 votes (entry lists 52 eps, 2021-2022, i.e. the first part)
magicchefoficeandfire.summary: Nian Bing was born able to wield both ice and fire magic, which makes him a target of the Ice God Pagoda. After escaping them he becomes the apprentice of a reclusive master chef and learns to cook with magic in a new city, growing stronger as dangers close in while he works toward becoming the continent's greatest mage.

apotheosis.name: Apotheosis
apotheosis.note: members-only gaps; S3 numbering restarts (EP1..EP106), may overlap S1-2 uploads

successofmmpyreanxuanemperor.name: The Success of Empyrean Xuan Emperor
successofmmpyreanxuanemperor.note: Anime-Planet 3.667 of 5 from 104 votes (season 1 page); ongoing multi-season
successofmmpyreanxuanemperor.summary: Wang Fan looks like an ordinary student at the Golden Academy, but he has mastered a powerful martial technique called the Empyrean Xuan Knack. When a senior he respects is wronged, he puts on the Silver Tiger King mask and starts taking revenge under a secret identity, while trying to keep his double life hidden.

斗罗大陆2绝世唐门.name: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan

wanjiezhizun.name: Supreme of All Realms (Wan Jie Zhi Zun)
wanjiezhizun.note: Anime-Planet 3.761 of 5 from 39 votes (entry lists 50 eps, 2022-2023); ongoing; overlaps key 万界至尊
wanjiezhizun.summary: Seven years ago a sudden disaster struck Chu Yunfei's family and left him stranded in the Pill King Valley of Zhongzhou. Now grown and far stronger, he returns to the wider world of martial cultivation with two goals: to take revenge on those responsible and to uncover the full truth of what happened to his family.

legendofsworddomain.name: The Legend of Sword Domain
legendofsworddomain.note: Anime-Planet 3.77 of 5 from 99 votes (season 1 page); ongoing, more seasons
legendofsworddomain.summary: Lv Yang is the son of a declining house among the five great families of the Sword Domain. While on the run he comes into possession of a legendary sword, and he trains with it to grow strong enough to learn what happened to his mother, all while the rival clans and factions around him scheme against one another.

godofwardominates.name: The God of War Dominates (Martial Master)
godofwardominates.note: MAL entry: Wushen Zhuzai; still airing (700+ eps), uploads are 20-ep compilations up to EP473
godofwardominates.summary: Qin Chen was once a peerless martial master who was betrayed and killed. He awakens hundreds of years later in the body of a scorned young man at a royal academy, looked down on by everyone around him. Using the knowledge and techniques from his past life, he sets out to rebuild his strength, protect the people close to him and uncover the truth behind his death.

wonderland.name: Wonderland
wonderland.note: MAL entry: Wan Jie Xian Zong 5th Season (eps 177-464); series ended at EP464 in July 2024

attackontitan.name: Attack on Titan
attackontitan.summary: Humanity survives behind giant walls that keep out Titans, huge man-eating beings. When a Titan breaches the outer wall and Eren Yeager watches his mother die, he vows to wipe them all out and joins the military with his friends Mikasa and Armin, hoping to fight on the front lines and uncover the secrets of the world outside.

rezerostartinglifeinanotherworld.name: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
rezerostartinglifeinanotherworld.note: S4 ended 2026-09-30 with 19 eps; only 16 S4 eps uploaded
rezerostartinglifeinanotherworld.summary: Shut-in Subaru Natsuki is suddenly transported from a convenience store to a fantasy kingdom, where he meets a half-elf girl named Emilia. He discovers that whenever he dies, time rewinds to an earlier point, leaving only him with memories of what happened. He uses this painful ability to protect Emilia and her allies from the dangers around them.

welcometodemonschoolirumakun.name: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
welcometodemonschoolirumakun.note: S4 (24 eps) finished 2026-09-27; rating rounded across seasons
welcometodemonschoolirumakun.summary: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki is sold by his careless parents to Sullivan, a powerful demon who simply wants a grandson. Whisked off to the Netherworld, Iruma is enrolled at Babyls, a school for demons, where being exposed as human could get him eaten. Kind to a fault and unable to refuse a request, he tries to keep his secret while making friends and quickly climbing the school's ranks.

taleofherdinggod.name: Tales of Herding Gods
taleofherdinggod.note: still airing; Anime-Planet 4.378 of 5 from 165 votes
taleofherdinggod.summary: Qin Mu is an orphan raised in a village of eccentric, disabled elders in the Great Ruins, a wasteland where monsters come out after dark. Each elder is secretly a master of some art, and they teach him everything they know. When he grows up, Qin Mu leaves the Ruins to see the outside world and uncover the truth about his origins and the gods that rule it.

lingwucontinent.name: Lingwu Continent
lingwucontinent.note: MAL entry: Ling Wu Dalu; still airing

urbanmiracledoctor.name: Urban Miracle Doctor
urbanmiracledoctor.note: MAL entry: Du Shi Gu Xian Yi; still airing (216/250 on iQIYI)

soulland2thepeerlesstangclan.name: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
soulland2thepeerlesstangclan.note: still airing; same show as 斗罗大陆2绝世唐门 key (overlapping compilations, not merged) and soulland S2 uploads
soulland2thepeerlesstangclan.summary: Thousands of years after the first Soul Land story, Huo Yuhao is the neglected son of a duke, living with his mistreated mother and born with a weak martial spirit. After tragedy strikes, he vows to grow strong enough for revenge, and a chance encounter with a powerful spirit beast sets him on the road to Shrek Academy.

supremelordofgalaxy.name: Supreme Lord of Galaxy
supremelordofgalaxy.note: members-only gaps; S3 uploads (EP86-112) overlap S2 numbering

greatruler.name: The Great Ruler
greatruler.note: S2 still airing (EP41 of 52 due Oct 2026); rating is MAL S2 (Da Zhuzai: Nian Fan 2)

2purpleriver.name: Purple River
2purpleriver.note: MAL lists 42 eps for S1 but 41 uploaded; S2 (52 eps) finished 2025

greatjourneyofteenagers.name: Great Journey of Teenagers
greatjourneyofteenagers.note: covers SP, S2, S3, S4 (all finished); S1 not uploaded here; sequel Nanming Li Huo exists

thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime-dub.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (English Dub)
thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime-dub.note: dub covers S1-S3 (S4 not dubbed yet)
thattimeigotreincarnatedasaslime-dub.summary: Satoru Mikami, an ordinary Tokyo office worker, is stabbed on the street and wakes up in a fantasy world reborn as a slime with a knack for absorbing and copying skills. After befriending a sealed storm dragon and taking the name Rimuru, he starts sheltering goblins and other monsters, aiming to build a peaceful nation where humans and monsters can live side by side.

gloriousrevengeofyefeng.name: Glorious Revenge of Ye Feng
gloriousrevengeofyefeng.note: MAL entry: Dubu Wangu 2nd Season; S1 uploads cover EP1-130 (S1+S2), 'S2' uploads EP21-46 are a newer season with a gap

immortality.name: Immortality
immortality.note: Yong Sheng; Anime-Planet 3.839 of 5 from 79 votes (season 1 entry); S5 finished May 2026
immortality.summary: Fang Han starts out as a lowly household slave who wants nothing more than to stand on his own and owe no one. Stumbling onto the secrets of martial cultivation, he begins remaking his body toward an immortal form. Driven by sheer stubbornness, he sets out through the realms of cultivation, dealing with the sect and former masters that once held him down.

superheroic.name: Super Heroic
superheroic.note: iQIYI 'Super Heroic' is Jueshi Zhan Hun (same Chinese title as superheroicspirit), likely the long-running 2021 version; not merged (different runs); members-only gaps (267 missing); no rating found (Anime-Planet 2021 entry lists only 60 eps)
superheroic.summary: On the Canglan Continent a cultivator's worth depends on the martial spirit he awakens, and Qin Nan's is so weak that everyone writes him off. When a lightning strike leaves him with a Divine Battle Spirit that can keep growing stronger, he sets out to overturn the rules that held him down and learn where the power came from.

supremealchemy.name: Supreme Alchemy
supremealchemy.note: MAL entry: Dan Dao Zhizun; still airing (193+ eps)

jojosbizarreadventureseason4part.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
jojosbizarreadventureseason4part.note: duplicate of jojosbizarreadventure (partial compilations of S2-S4)

yishiduzun.name: The Lone Sword Overlord (Yi Shi Du Zun)
yishiduzun.note: members-only gaps; series ended at EP165 (Oct 2025)

demonhunter.name: The Demon Hunter
demonhunter.note: members-only gaps in S2; MAL entry: Cang Yuan Tu 2; overlaps 2thedemonhunter (not merged)
demonhunter.summary: In a world where demons break through into human lands and ordinary people rely on martial warriors for protection, Meng Chuan grows up in Dongning in the shadow of a mother who fought the demons. Determined to protect his family and his city, he devotes himself to the sword and the long road of cultivation, aiming to become strong enough to stand against the demon hordes.

jadedynasty.name: Jade Dynasty
jadedynasty.summary: Zhang Xiaofan is an ordinary village boy whose home is wiped out in a single night, leaving him one of the few survivors. Taken in by the Qingyun Sect, he struggles as its least gifted disciple while secretly carrying teachings from another school and a strange weapon, and his quiet life gradually gets tangled in the conflict between righteous sects and demonic factions.

landofmiracles.name: The Land of Miracles
landofmiracles.note: 1 episode missing in S1; S2/S3 are single collections; show finished 2023
landofmiracles.summary: Fa Hua and Lan Ge, two teenagers from very different backgrounds, are bound together by the Only Pearl, a magical artifact meant to protect humanity. Growing into an almost sibling-like pair through training and trials, they must guard the Pearl when a member of a sky demon clan comes hunting for it, setting them on a path of cultivation and revenge.

legendaryoverlord.name: Legendary Overlord
legendaryoverlord.note: series ended 2022 (3 seasons + special); uploads stop at EP77, may be slightly short; verify

beelzebub.name: Beelzebub
beelzebub.summary: Tatsumi Oga is the most feared delinquent at Ishiyama High, a school full of thugs. One day he pulls a man out of a river who splits open to reveal a baby, the son of the Demon Lord, who latches onto Oga as his guardian. With the demon maid Hilda watching over them, Oga must raise the infant to destroy humanity while fending off a steady stream of rival brawlers.

mushokutenseijoblessreincarnation.name: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
mushokutenseijoblessreincarnation.note: S3 cour 1 (14 eps) ended Sept 2026; cour 2 announced for 2027
mushokutenseijoblessreincarnation.summary: A jobless, reclusive man in his thirties dies in an accident and is reborn as Rudeus Greyrat, an infant in a world of swords and magic who keeps all his old memories. Determined not to waste his second life, he throws himself into learning magic from a young age. As he grows up, he makes friends, finds teachers and faces the challenges his past self always ran from.

ludijianxian.name: Lu Di Jian Xian (Keyboard Immortal)
ludijianxian.note: 150 eps finished; no rating found; Anime-Planet 3.645 of 5 from 34 votes

foxspiritmatchmaker.name: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
foxspiritmatchmaker.note: S13 (Huangfeng Ridge arc) still airing in 2026; S8 missing 1 ep; many seasons not uploaded; rating approx. across seasons (S1 7.14, S6 7.37); Anime-Planet S1 entry 3.468 of 5 from 1048 votes
foxspiritmatchmaker.summary: In a world where humans and demons live side by side, fox spirits of the Tushan clan run a matchmaking business. When a human and a demon fall in love and one of them dies and is reborn, the foxes help the surviving partner restore the lost memories so the couple can reunite. Tushan Susu, a young fox, and Bai Yuechu, a human Taoist, are drawn into these cases.

superheroicspirit.name: Super Heroic Spirit
superheroicspirit.note: Jueshi Zhan Hun (2024); Anime-Planet 3.90 of 5 from 53 votes; S1 180 eps complete in one upload; S2 (2026, 100 eps) airing, only a few eps uploaded
superheroicspirit.summary: On the Canglan Continent a cultivator's worth depends on the martial spirit he awakens, and Qin Nan's is so weak that he becomes a laughingstock. After a lightning strike gives him a Divine Battle Spirit that can level up, he starts climbing past those who mocked him and uncovering the secrets behind his new power.

aceofdiamondact.name: Ace of Diamond Act II
aceofdiamondact.note: starts mid-story: Act II; Ace of Diamond S1-S2 not uploaded; MAL lists 52 eps, only 51 uploaded
aceofdiamondact.summary: Eijun Sawamura is now a second-year pitcher at Seido High School, a powerhouse baseball program in Tokyo. With the older team leaders gone, he competes with his teammates, including rival pitcher Satoru Furuya and a promising new batch of first-years, for the ace number, while the team aims for a return to the national tournament at Koshien.

bloodriver.name: Blood River
bloodriver.note: live action drama (Gong Jun / Peng Xiaoran)

greatruler-dub.name: The Great Ruler (English Dub)
greatruler-dub.note: MAL entry: Da Zhuzai: Nian Fan; second year-long season still airing in 2026
greatruler-dub.summary: In a vast universe of stacked realms where talented fighters from lower worlds rise to fame, Mu Chen is the son of the lord of the Northern Spirit Realm. He sets out on the path of spiritual cultivation, aiming to climb from his home realm into the wider Great Thousand World, facing rivals and dark forces while growing strong enough to stand beside the people he cares about.

shangrilafrontier.name: Shangri-La Frontier
shangrilafrontier.note: S1 as one compilation video, S2 per episode
shangrilafrontier.summary: Rakuro Hizutome is a high schooler who loves beating broken, badly made video games. For a change of pace he tries Shangri-La Frontier, a hugely popular full-dive VR game, playing as the bird-masked Sunraku. The skills he honed on glitchy games let him stumble onto rare quests and powerful monsters that most players never find, and he sets out to push the game to its limits.

howdareyou.name: How Dare You!?
howdareyou.note: MAL entry: Cheng He Titong (S1 7.99, S2 7.76); animated version, not the 2026 live action
howdareyou.summary: Office worker Yu Wanwan wakes up inside a palace-intrigue novel as a scheming imperial consort who is fated to die badly. She soon learns that the feared tyrant emperor Xia Houdan is also a stranger from the modern world, and the two form a wary alliance, using what they know of the story to outwit court factions and change their doomed endings.

spyfamily.name: SPY x FAMILY
spyfamily.note: S1 part 1+2, S2, S3 (all 50 eps); Anime-Planet vote-weighted 4.34 of 5 from 66460 votes (S1p1 4.4/34334, S1p2 4.309/17827, S2 4.2/10011, S3 4.27/4288)
spyfamily.summary: Twilight, a top spy for the nation of Westalis, must get close to a reclusive politician whose son attends an elite academy. Posing as psychiatrist Loid Forger, he adopts a girl named Anya and marries office clerk Yor to build a fake family. He does not know that Anya can read minds and Yor is a professional assassin, and each hides their secret while trying to keep the household together.

againstthegods.name: Against the Gods
againstthegods.note: S2 (Nian Fan) still airing (52 planned); members-only gaps
againstthegods.summary: Yun Che, chased to a cliff for the precious item he carries, jumps to his death and wakes in the body of another young man with the same name, a crippled youth mocked by his clan. He carries the Sky Poison Pearl and soon meets Jasmine, a mysterious star god. With newly awakened talents, he sets out to settle scores, protect his loved ones and rise above those who looked down on him.

ahirunosora.name: Ahiru no Sora
ahirunosora.note: regular TV anime (Diomedea), not AI; Anime-Planet 3.757 of 5 from 3441 votes
ahirunosora.summary: Sora Kurumatani is a first-year high schooler who is far shorter than most players but determined to play basketball, the sport his mother taught him. Borrowing a stranger's fame and powers, he has to decide whether he can earn people's trust as himself.
